messages:
maria: Morning — quick sync on v2 route rollout & launch criteria. We need a concise acceptance checklist that covers chat/completions, embeddings, rerank/tool-calls, structured output, plus a deprecation timeline customers can rely on. Thoughts?

ajay: short: we already have v2 route prototypes for chat/completions/embeddings. biggest gaps: function-calling surface (schema changes) and rerank contract. also need deterministic fallback mapping to v1.

leah: propose checklist items: 1) end-to-end parity tests for top-20 customer prompt sets, 2) quality delta < 2% failure/regression on evals, 3) latency regressions <= 10% at P50/P95, 4) canary rollback automation.

simon: routing note — prefer header opt-in for initial rollout: `X-Redwood-Compat: v1`/`v2` so customers can opt-in per-route. fallback: if v2 errors, route to pinned v1 variant. need route-mapping table stored in cfg service.

tess: customers will want a migration guide + SDK examples. request we include: migration checklist, snippet for adding header, sample migration test harness, and recommended fallback behavior for enterprise. also propose migration office hours.

chao: embeddings: watch out for small vector normalization/scale diffs across model variants. add a migration note: "reindex recommended" when dimension/normalization changes or when quantization alters vector distribution. provide sample reindex script.

ajay: deprecation timeline draft: opt-in phase (days 0-30) with `X-Redwood-Compat` header; advisory-only warnings for 30-90; default new users to v2 after 90; 180 days later warn again; 360 days deprecate v1 route for public tenants (enterprise opt-out possible). open to negotiation.

maria: that timeline looks aggressive for some large customers. can we make it configurable per-tenant for Dedicated/Private?

simon: yes — Dedicated/Private can have contract-based freeze windows. Public hosted tenants follow the baseline timeline but we gate by canary metrics.

leah: canary plan: start 1% (internal) -> 5% external -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, weekly ramps with mandatory metric checks at each step: error rate, latency delta, quality delta on sampled prompts. stop if any gate fails.

ajay: acceptance test types: unit contract tests, synthetic load tests, recorded-prompts A/B, and replay tests against customer prompt snapshots (with consent/PII scrubbed). create a minimal test harness in `infra/e2e/v2-compat`.

duk: from support: need customer comms templates: migration email, in-console banner copy, and a KB with step-by-step SDK examples. also request 2 migration office hours before making default changes.

leah: add automatic compatibility-check step in CI that compares v1/v2 outputs on canonical prompt sets, fails CI on >2% token-level mismatch for core intents.

chao: also add an embeddings-specific eval: cosine parity + downstream retrieval AUC on sample datasets. include a threshold for "reindex required" flag.

simon: infra SLOs: fallback path must add <300ms median extra latency, error-rate on v2 <0.1% at launch. capacity planning: reserve 20% headroom for rollouts.

maria: owners: ajay -> rollout + rollback automation, leah -> test harness & acceptance suite, simon -> routing/fallback infra, tess -> customer comms & migration docs, chao -> embeddings eval & reindex guidance, duk -> support playbook.

ajay: I'll draft a short RFC with exact gates and the rollout script. plan to open PR by EOD. :nerd_face:

deploy-bot: release branch `v2-compat-rollout/1914001234` created for staging canary. CI: waiting for tests.

maria: perfect. next sync Friday 10am. add items to the roadmap cadence and track in the product board. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

duk: noted, will draft comms and schedule office hours.

leah: leaving action items in the checklist doc and adding example `curl` snippets for header opt-in:```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Compat: v1" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/chat```
